item.title: Brewers edge Padres 3-2 in NLDS opener that features bizarre play in 9th inning
item.description: William Contreras hit a tiebreaking homer in the seventh inning and the Milwaukee Brewers hung on to beat San Diego 3-2 in their NL Division Series opener after a potential go-ahead homer by the Padres’ Ty France hit the American Family Field roof and landed in outfielder Jackson Chourio’s glove for an out

item.title: Crews find 'debris field' from 6-person medical flight missing over the Atlantic en route to Boston
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard says searchers have found a “debris field” off the coast of Nantucket from an air ambulance carrying six people that vanished over the Atlantic

item.title: Cyclospora found at Mexican farm linked to lettuce outbreak, FDA says
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration says it found the cyclospora parasite at a Mexican farm identified as the source of a massive lettuce-borne outbreak

item.title: US hiring slows and unemployment ticks higher with a month remaining before Americans head to polls
item.description: U.S. employers added a disappointing 29,000 jobs and the unemployment rate ticked up last month, according to new data, a month before voters go to the polls in pivotal midterm elections at a time of discontent over the high cost of living and the state of the economy

item.title: Mormon leader decries explosion in sports betting, prediction markets
